inputs.model.prompt: The input images are the first and last frames: @image1 is the wide pool view before the activity starts, @image2 is the final top-down view. Smooth cinematic transition, 5 seconds. [0-1.5s] Starting from the first frame, the camera pushes in from the wide view toward the quiet pool, people standing around the edges, activity not yet started. [1.5-3.5s] Swimmers begin jumping into the pool one after another, splashes erupting, the crowd getting excited and lively, many people in swimsuits leaping in from all sides. [3.5-5s] The camera rises to a top-down view as everyone plays in the water, the pool packed and splashing, landing exactly on the last frame image. No black frames, no jump cuts.
